paragraphs.text: This earnest affection declares that he is free from hypocrisy and that sluggishness does not stop him.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: He prophecies of the calling of the Gentiles: for unless they were called, they could not hear the goodness of God.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: Let all the world see your judgments in that you are God over all, and so confess that you are glorious.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: When God by his benefits makes us partakers of his mercies, he admonishes us to be earnest in prayer, to desire him to continue and finish his graces.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: As he has spoken to Samuel concerning me, so will he show himself constant and holy in his promise, so that these nations following will be subject to me.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: From the sixth verse of this psalm to the last, read also Ps 60:5.
paragraphs.label: f
